chipmunk.name: Chip
chipmunk.description: A tiny, bright, high-pitched cartoon chipmunk. Fast, excitable, warm, slightly squeaky, youthful, very expressive.

beaver.name: Archie
beaver.description: A confident, optimistic builder and engineer beaver. Warm, steady, mid-range voice, calm and capable, not loud. Sounds like someone who knows exactly what he is doing and enjoys the work. Friendly, with a slight smile in the voice.
